description: Supplement to M5 East motorway: environmental impact statement: working papers vol. 1 of 3 is a dataset listed in Australian national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by NSW Government. This volume contains specialist papers covering the M5 East Motorway: variation from Bexley Road to General Holmes drive (zoning); variation from Bexley Road to General Holmes Drive (land use and social impacts); tunnelling; soils and groundwater; construction and operational activities on fish and decapods in wetlands habitats; Padstow to Botany/Mascot Aboriginal heritage; air quality assessment ... Coverage: NSW Government. The portal files it under the publisher NSW Government. Its tags are Roads and Traffic Authority of New South Wales, bexley road, fauna, flora, general holmes drive. It offers 1 resource(s) in PDF. The portal shows 2025-12-19 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is licence code "lsba" on the portal (not expanded on the listing). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-au-portal.
